source.quote: WiiM's own product page for the WiiM Ultra, read 2026-11-24. Internal DAC IC: « ESS ES9038Q2M », described in prose as « Premium 32-bit/384kHz ES9038 Q2M SABRE DAC ». Audio Input list: « 1 x Optical In: » « Up to 192 kHz/24-bit » and « 1 x HDMI ARC: » « Up to 192 kHz/24-bit », both « Supports Stereo PCM and Dolby Digital (DTS is not supported) ». Product comparison table category: « Music Streamer »; Main Purpose: « Connected to amplifier or powered speaker for streaming ».

facts.chip: ES9038Q2M (ESS), named by the maker as « Internal DAC IC: ESS ES9038Q2M ». No separate USB interface chip or clock is stated.

_no_usb_audio_input: USB on this device is an OUTPUT, not an input: the page lists « 1 x USB Out (up to 192 kHz/24-bit; UAC 2.0 compliant) » and its comparison row reads « USB Port (Storage/Audio Out) ». So unlike eversolo/dmp-a8 this record is a network player and nothing else, and `kind` is not strained.
_what_is_not_asserted: NO DSD FIELD AT ALL. The maker's page does not mention DSD, DoP or a DSD rate anywhere, so dsd_max, native_dsd and dop are ABSENT - nobody filled them in - rather than "unknown", which would claim the question was asked and closed. No coaxial INPUT is listed either (coax is output only), and no network streaming rate is stated: the page gives a codec list and no rate limit. Nothing of level 3: the page mentions room correction and EQ and never says whether they can be bypassed.
